alfalfa_corte_verano.por_que_en: Keeps the stand and plans a summer rest: 2–3 irrigations are skipped between July and September. Trials report that yield always drops and that stand survival depends on the soil.
alfalfa_corte_verano.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), option B (moderate variant, update of Oct 29): INIFAP La Laguna 2008; UC ANR 8522 (2015); Bali et al. 2024. Trials from other regions; no published trial in DR-005
alfalfa_corte_verano.etiqueta: [V] trials from other regions; assumption [S] for DR-005

regla.ventana_por_cultivo: the one in «secuencia.siembra» of each option (MM-DD)

filtros.texto_en: Planting must fall inside the window reported for the crop.

texto_por_opcion_en.cereal_sorgo: No local planting window was found for sorghum, so this rule checks the winter cereal and not the sorghum.

filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 1 (INIFAP planting dates by crop)

regla.nota: the master document sets no threshold: the frost probability of heladas.json for the planting date is shown and nothing is decided

filtros.texto_en: Chile planted from February is exposed to late frost. The card shows the chance of frost after the planting date; it does not decide.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 2; probability computed with NASA POWER (heladas.json). INEGI 1983: last frost in March and earliest in November
filtros.etiqueta: [V] rule; the probability is for a regional grid cell, not a station

filtros.texto_en: Do not plant chile after chile. After a Phytophthora capsici outbreak, keep at least 5 years without host crops. The satellite memory shows summer crops but not which crop, so this needs a local check.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 3: Silva-Rojas et al. 2009 (Delicias and Camargo; the stricter criterion is adopted); INIFAP gives 4 years

filtros.texto_en: Cotton stalks must be shredded within 10 days after harvest and uprooted before November 30 (official plant-health rule NOM-026).
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 4; INIFAP, Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Chihuahua 2017 (NOM-026)

regla.nota: compared live with the chosen allocation; 40 cm = 4 thousand m³/ha just to establish the alfalfa

filtros.texto_en: Alfalfa should not be established in a dry year: it needs about 40 cm of irrigation just to establish.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 5; INIFAP, Agenda Técnica Agrícola de Chihuahua 2017 (40 cm in five irrigations of 8 cm)

filtros.texto_en: Leave at least 12 months between one alfalfa stand and the next (autotoxicity).
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 6. Fundación Produce Chihuahua gives a minimum of 6–7 months (secondary source); the stricter value is adopted

regla.unidad: ECe en dS/m; pérdida en % por cada dS/m por encima del umbral
regla.nota: oats and triticale have no numeric threshold in FAO-29 («moderately tolerant»). The ECe of the soil is not the EC of the irrigation water

filtros.texto_en: Salt tolerance differs by crop (FAO thresholds for soil salinity). There is no measured soil salinity for this field, so this needs a local check.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 7: FAO-29, Table 4 (ECe threshold of the soil saturation extract, dS/m, and yield loss per dS/m above it); values from S2 §3, which the master document declares current. Cotton, wheat and barley: list of the same filter

filtros.texto_en: If atrazine was used on the previous maize or sorghum, labels ask to wait 5–10 months depending on the next crop and not to sow alfalfa. Check the label of the exact product.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), filter 8: Mexican atrazine labels (Tridente and ADAMA), verified in S2 §3

filtros.texto_en: For an established stand; never in its year of establishment.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), option B: offered for an established alfalfa stand, never in its year of establishment

filtros.texto_en: Skipping summer irrigations is reasonable on deep, non-sandy soil without high salinity, and not elsewhere; risk is high on heavy clay under extreme heat. Soil texture and salinity are not measured for this field: needs a local check.
filtros.fuente: Project master document, §5.2 (v3.1, Oct 29, 2026), option B and its update of Oct 29 (Bali et al. 2024; UC ANR 8522)

opciones_del_maestro_no_entregadas.D_avena_veza: Option D of the master document (autumn–winter oat–vetch). Not delivered: the demand model (A5) has no sourced crop coefficient for the mix, and the master document marks seed, buyer and calendar in Delicias as not verified.
opciones_del_maestro_no_entregadas.E_sorgo_con_1_2_auxilios: Option E of the master document (sorghum with 1–2 supplementary irrigations). Not delivered as such: A5 computes sorghum with its full demand and the sources give no depth for a supplementary sorghum irrigation. The part «the rest rests with standing stubble» is the «descanso» option.
